model.final_optimization: all amplitudes, phases, mean magnitude, and frequency fine-tuned simultaneously
model.frequency_initialization: Lomb-Scargle highest-amplitude frequency followed by consecutive harmonic pre-whitening

primary_variant_rationale: The article names curve_fit but does not state that per-point sigma values were supplied. The unweighted free-frequency fit therefore uses the fewest undocumented assumptions. Weighted and fixed-period variants are retained as a method lattice rather than discarded.

publication.citation: Jurkovic et al. (2022/2023), Type II and anomalous Cepheids in the Kepler K2 mission, MNRAS 518, 642-663

source_scope.surveys: OGLE-III and OGLE-IV merged when both were available

uncertainty.k2_sample_only: 100 bootstrap resamples using 60 percent of measurements
uncertainty.ogle_comparison: square root of diagonal covariance returned by scipy.optimize.curve_fit
uncertainty.phase17_correction: The Phase-17 anchor method_summary conflated the K2 bootstrap with the OGLE comparison. Phase 18 preserves Phase 17 historically and supplies this corrected method contract.

unpublished_dimensions: exact curve_fit call signature and weighting policy
